author: Aida Cloutier
title: Great time waster
content: This app is entertaining in many respects with a great variety of slot games and different ways to win.  I do find it complicated to track down when & where you receive the free chips and bonuses as they seem to be hiding all over the place.  It’s also an app where bets begin high and go much higher with many of the slots requiring a minimum of $30m to $150,000m to even play.  I do find the larger amounts to be unrealistic more than anything else, but then I come from a gambling state, so I guess that’s to be expected.  One thing I don’t like are apps that pay big when you first begin playing … to draw you in, I suppose.  Then, once you’ve one a large amount of chips you begin steadily losing.  I always supposed that this was a way of getting players to buy chips and I find it irritating.  However,  Cash Frenzy - even with all its interruptions and notifications - is a fun app and I find myself in there quite frequently these days.  Give it a try!
